It's everybody we know.|Asara Deyn and Gedeek Obaz|}} The '''Imperial Security Bureau''' ('''ISB'''), also referred to as the '''Imperial Security Office''' or the '''Imperial Secret Service''', was an internal [[Law enforcement agency|security]] and intelligence agency of the [[Galactic Empire]] that was charged with defending it against security threats from within and ensuring the loyalty of citizens in the Empire. Aside from that, it happened to be one of the many umbrella organizations under the greater [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR), and was larger than its sister agency [[Imperial Intelligence]]. It was led by [[ISB high command]], while the [[ISB Board]] oversaw certain [[sector]]s. ==Organization== ===Command hierarchy and administration=== {{Quote|Security is an illusion. You want security? Call the Navy. Launch a regiment of troopers. We are healthcare providers. We treat sickness. We identify symptoms. We locate germs whether they arise from within or have come from the outside. The longer we wait to identify a disorder, the harder it is to treat the disease.|ISB Major Lio Partagaz|}} [[File:Hatching_a_Plan_AtG.png|thumb|left|250px|Colonel Yularen was a high ranking officer within the ISB who became its director.]] Tasked with homeland security measures,''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' the Imperial Security Bureau was a sister agency and rival to [[Imperial Intelligence]]. The Bureau worked closely with Emperor Palpatine, under which served [[Deputy Director]] [[Harus Ison]], who operated in conjunction with the [[Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military|Joint Chiefs]] as a member of that board.''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' Working alongside Ison and joining him as an ISB representee on the Joint Chiefs was [[Colonel]] Wullf Yularen, who further served as the liaison between the ISB and Imperial Intelligence, connecting the two agencies of the Security branch. In time, Yularen would rise to become the ISB director: that position, combined with his rank of colonel, linked up well to the level of authority he held as a [[Fleet Admiral]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. On the field, ISB was sometimes attached to various [[fleet]]s, sometimes falling under the command of the Navy and working alongside the [[Naval Intelligence Agency]]. Members of the ISB worked from the [[Imperial Security Bureau Central Office]] as part of the [[Federal District]] on Coruscant, while agents in the field would constantly provide intelligence updates to headquarters. The ISB used a martial structure to their organization's ranks. Such ranks included, from junior to senior, [[ensign]], [[lieutenant]],{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} [[Flag Lieutenant|flag lieutenant]],''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' [[captain]], [[commander]],''[[Cyphers and Masks]]'' [[Senior Commander|senior commander]], [[major]], [[colonel]],{{StoryCite|story=The Levers of Power|book=The Rise of the Empire}} [[general]], and [[admiral]].''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]'' Positions in the ISB included that of [[Chief Investigator]], [[chief supervisor]],''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]'' [[ISB Supervisor]], [[ISB Attendant]], [[loyalty officer]], [[Inspector General]], [[Deputy Director|deputy director]], [[director]], [[intelligence officer]],{{Andor|Announcement}} and [[minister]].''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' The [[ISB high command]] governed the ISB, while the [[ISB Board]] led by Major [[Lio Partagaz]] coordinated intelligence tasks per sector. Many military officers feared the group and its power. That fear also spread into the general population as the ISB cemented its reputation, with the [[Ferrixian]] [[Bix Caleen]] knowing of the ISB as "the worst of the worst" of all Imperial personnel.{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} ===Personnel=== {{Quote|As an agent of the ISB, I follow the letter of the law.|Agent Alexsandr Kallus|''[[The Rebellion Begins]]''}} [[File:ISB_badge.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An ISB badge]] Prospective ISB personnel were drawn from the [[Imperial Academy]] system and given training within the [[ISB Academy and Offices]] complex, located within the [[Verity District]] on Coruscant. Members went through a training regimen which included learning [[Xenophobia|xenophobic]] propaganda, and were taught from the ''[[ISB Loyalty Manual]]''. Members of the ISB were taught a specialized vocabulary to prevent outsiders from understanding their conversations. The term "auditing" was used to signal that suspects knew they were being investigated. The practice of provoking a suspect to commit a crime was referred to as "crustbusting," and interrogating a supposed innocent in the hope that they would react suspiciously was known as "scattering." Framing a wanted suspect for a crime to make sure that they would be arrested was referred to as "Jabba." ISB members may have seen themselves as an ideologically pure branch of the Empire, as was reflected by the gleaming white of the ISB Central Office on Coruscant.{{InsiderCite|227|World Building (Star Wars Insider 227)}} Following completion of the Academy, recruits filed into one of several branches of the organization, such as [[Surveillance (Imperial Security Bureau)|Surveillance]], [[Interrogation (Imperial Security Bureau)|Interrogation]], and [[Re-Education]]. Agent [[Gudry]] displayed skill in both investigating and defending Imperial personnel.[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']] [[File:ISBSlicer-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|ISB slicers at work]] High-ranking ISB agents could command stormtrooper [[squad]]s, override orders of civilian and military authorities, replace questionable officers and commandeer Imperial military hardware, including [[Star Destroyer]]s. Loyalty officers of the ISB{{StoryCite|story=The Levers of Power|book=The Rise of the Empire}} were tasked with ensuring that regular [[troop]]s and officers obeyed orders and conformed to Imperial ideology, and were regarded with great fear and respect. Impromptu inspections, undercover surveillance and seemingly limitless authority gave such officers unprecedented access to the lives of regular servicemen, creating a culture of fear to deter any tenuous links within the chain of command. While most ISB agents were human, at least one [[Gotal]] named [[Barrisk Favvin]] worked as an ISB agent in the [[Kupoh]]an city of [[Tonekh]]. ===Enforcement=== {{Main|Enforcement (Imperial Security Bureau)}} [[File:ISBagents-Shatterpoint.png|thumb|right|250px|ISB agents in field armor]] The Enforcement branch of the ISB served as backup for agents in the field, specially trained to provide support when necessary. ===Interrogation=== {{Main|Interrogation (Imperial Security Bureau)}} Interrogation was the second-largest branch in the ISB, and was intent on extracting information from various lifeforms to obtain valuable information. It claimed to have a ninety-five percent success rate in recovering useful data from questioned subjects. To that end, the ISB notably used [[IT-O interrogation droid|IT-O Interrogation Units]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' developed by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research]].{{Databank|interrogation-droid|Interrogation Droid}} ===Re-Education=== {{Main|Re-Education}} The Re-Education division was focused on what some called "[[brain]]washing" its subjects into supporting the Galactic Empire and its actions across the galaxy. [[Project Unity]] consisted of re-educating elements of society resistant to the New Order through a process of psychological manipulation and pharmaceutical conditioning.''[[Servants of the Empire: The Secret Academy]]'' ===Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research=== {{Main|Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research}} Advanced Weapons Research was an agency responsible for special research and development of classified weapons, with the agency operating as part of both [[Imperial Intelligence]] and the ISB. Weapons development fell under the arm of Imperial Intelligence whereas defense of the agency's secrets fell to the ISB. [[Engineer]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]]'s role as [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research]] was considered to be something done under the ISB organizational structure while also being done on behalf of the Imperial Military.{{Databank|director-orson-krennic|Director Orson Krennic}} Furthermore, [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] identified Krennic's role as Director of Advanced Weapons Research and the [[Tarkin Initiative]] itself as parts of the ISB. On top of that, Krennic was also identified as an officer of the ISB.{{InsiderCite|231|Most Wanted: Cassian Andor and Associates}} ===Internal Affairs=== {{Main|Internal Affairs}} The Internal Affairs division maintained order by investigating possible instances of insubordination within the Empire, with Yularen briefly heading a division dedicated to exposing sedition within the Imperial Senate before becoming Deputy Director of the Naval Intelligence Agency. In addition, a single Internal Affairs officer was stationed aboard all [[Star]] Destroyers to investigate any signs of sedition among the crew. ===Investigations=== {{Main|Investigations}} Investigations was a branch of the Imperial Security Bureau that investigated issues both internally in the [[Galactic Empire]] and externally. Its members included [[ISB Supervisor]]s, who met as a governing body known as the [[ISB Board]] at the [[ISB Central Office]] on [[Coruscant]]. Members of the board were assigned [[sector]]s to manage, and often partook in direct communication with local regional governments, and used previously collected data to suppress rebel activity. ===Tactical=== [[File:Isb tactical who else knows.png|thumb|left|250px|ISB Tactical agents partaking in a raid]] {{Main|ISB Tactical}} [[ISB Tactical]]{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} was a task force in the ISB{{Databank|sergeant-benzi|Sergeant Benzi}} deployed for operations. Members of ISB Tactical wore varying types of [[Stormtrooper armor]], and put together specialized task forces based on the provided mission. Members of other branches of the ISB such as [[Investigations]] could request an operation, which could be overseen from a [[Imperial Security Bureau control center|control room]] at the [[ISB Central Office]]. ===Special Operations=== {{Main|Special Operations Division}} The Special Operations Division was responsible for varying tasks within the Bureau, such as establishing [[Project Hidden Eye]] during the Galactic Civil War. ===Surveillance=== {{Main|Surveillance (Imperial Security Bureau)}} Operatives in the Surveillance branch were by far the most numerous, with its members focused on deciphering encrypted information and analyzing data to screen for potential threats against the New Order. ===Zerek Besh=== {{Main|Zerek Besh}} {{Quote|The ISB has created the most groundbreaking intelligence network the Empire has seen and accomplished more in weeks than the entire Imperial army.|Sliro Barsha heralds the ISB's success|}} [[File:ZerekBesh-Symbol.svg|thumb|right|150px|The secret Zerek Besh intelligence network, publicly a crime syndicate.]] [[Zerek Besh]] was a criminal syndicate active in [[the galaxy]] that, in secret, was actually an arm of the ISB used to infiltrate the criminal underworld in search of members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and to gather information from the galaxy's syndicates.[[Crimson Reign 5|''Crimson Reign'' 5]] Formed around [[3 ABY]]''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' establishes that Zerek Besh was a new syndicate during its events, which occur in [[3 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:OutlawsDate|here]]. Therefore, Zerek Besh was formed around 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. by Director [[Sliro Barsha]], Zerek Besh engaged in criminal activity as one of the underworld's most powerful syndicates[[Hidden Empire 1|''Hidden Empire'' 1]] but was thought of by Barsha as an intelligence gathering network. Loyal to the Empire even though Zerek Besh functioned as his own personal crime family, Barsha believed Zerek Besh would help defeat the Rebel Alliance to bring forth Imperial victory in the Galactic Civil War, only for his own ambitions to clash with those of his brother, [[Jaylen Vrax]], and culminate in both of their deaths. Nonetheless, Zerek Besh would survive and fall under the influence of a new leader. ==History== ===Early growth=== ====Foundation==== {{Quote|We're here to further security objectives by collecting intelligence, providing useful analysis, and conducting effective covert action, sir.|The ISB mission statement, as quoted by Dedra Meero|}} [[File:Andressa_Divo_SaV.png|thumb|left|250px|Agent [[Andressa Divo]] stands with other agents and stormtroopers of the ISB.]] The Imperial Security Bureau was formed by [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] in [[19 BBY]] as a secret [[Law enforcement agency|law enforcement organization]]. As a home front security organization, it was dedicated to rooting out enemies of the [[New Order]] and the Galactic Empire and maintaining stability throughout Imperial territories shortly after the [[proclamation of the New Order]] and throughout the reign of the Empire. Initially, however, while the bureau was still being established in 19 BBY,{{MOFdate|7}} many of its tasks fell on Imperial Intelligence, much to the annoyance of Imperial Intelligence operative [[Haki Zeophrine]]. Within fourteen [[Standard year|years]], however, the organization would grow from a handful of [[agent]]s into an organization double the size of Imperial Intelligence. Following the Clone Wars, the agency helped oversee the dismantling of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Confederate]] [[warship]]s and martial supplies. Concurrent loyalty purges saw vast amounts of Separatist [[propaganda]] destroyed, rescinded, and withheld. Only a handful of propaganda [[Painting|posters]], such as artist [[Ansibella Dellu]]'s work ''[[Count Dooku: Words of Truth]]'', escaped the purges. When [[Art Group]] agents discovered egregious violations of its artistic tenets, agents of the ISB were called in to make troublesome [[artist]]s disappear.''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' [[14 BBY|Five years]] into the Emperor's [[Imperial Era|reign]], Imperial Intelligence agents found a cache of communications devices on the remote [[Planet|world]] of [[Murkhana]] and referred the case to the ISB, who brought the matter to the Emperor and his [[Imperial Ruling Council]]. It was ultimately decided to [[Mission to Murkhana|dispatch]] [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] to investigate the cache, which was in reality set up by a [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|small rebel cell]], despite the ISB hoping to receive full oversight of the investigation from Imperial Intelligence and the [[Naval Intelligence Agency]]. During that same year,''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' to [[14 BBY]]. the ISB maintained an active operation on the planet [[Zeffo]], a world that was of interest to the Emperor's [[Project Auger]]. Signs posted by the Bureau on Imperial equipment warned residents of a [[Abandoned Village|local village]] that [[Thief|looters]] of the project would be [[Death|shot]] on sight.''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' ====Hunt for the Jedi Cal Kestis==== {{Quote|Cal Kestis. I'd assumed the first time we met you'd be strapped to an interrogation chair.|Lank Denvik, to Cal Kestis|}} [[File:Lank_Denvik.jpg|thumb|right|200px|ISB chief supervisor, Lank Denvik, intended to capture Jedi Knight Cal Kestis.]] In [[9 BBY]], [[Lank Denvik]], a member of the ISB, began an operation designed to capture [[Jedi Knight]] [[Cal Kestis]], a target of great interest to the Empire. Denvik sent his spy, [[Bode Akuna]], to infiltrate Kestis's team. Akuna was a former Jedi who survived the Purge that destroyed the [[Jedi Order]]. Having met Denvik during the Clone Wars, the two struck a deal. Denvik would hide Akuna from the rest of the Empire, especially the [[Inquisitorius]], an organization dedicated to eliminating surviving Jedi, which Denvik despised, if Akuna worked for him. Akuna's daughter, [[Kata Akuna|Kata]], was part of the deal. In addition to protection, Denvik would reveal the identity of the [[Inquisitor]] who killed Akuna's [[Tayala Akuna|wife]]. In addition to Kestis, Denvik also targeted [[Cere Junda]], an ally of Kestis who was conducting an operation on the moon [[Jedha]]. However, Akuna decided to leave the ISB to go with his daughter to [[Tanalorr]], a world beyond the reach of the Empire. Akuna stole the compass that would show the way to Tanalorr from Kestis and lured him to Denvik's [[II-0810 Satellite Station|station]] in the [[Nova Garon system]] to use Kestis' invasion as a distraction to escape with his daughter. Akuna and his daughter escaped and Denvik was confronted and defeated by Kestis, and as Akuna's actions on Jedha attracted Darth Vader's attention, Denvik told Kestis to kill him, as he believed it would be better than being killed by Vader. Though Kestis felt very much like killing Denvik for sending Akuna and causing Junda's death, he spared the ISB member. What Denvik feared eventually came true when Vader went to the station and executed him. Denvik was [[Force choke|strangled]] with the use of [[the Force]]. Due to the actions of the station personnel and Kestis' escape, the Inquisitorius not only took control of the station but also killed all the ISB members present. ===The growing rebellion=== ====Hunt for Andor==== [[File:ISB_begin_their_hunt.png|thumb|left|300px|Cassian Andor was a target of ISB investigations into the theft of Imperial equipment.]] By [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|1}} by which point Colonel Wullf Yularen was serving as ISB director, the ISB's Investigations branch had established a "[[ISB conference room|war room]]" at its [[ISB Central Office|Central Office]] in [[Coruscant]]. ISB agents were assigned oversight over different sectors in the galaxy and regularly reported to [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]]. Some ISB agents such as [[Lieutenant]] [[Blevin]] jealously guarded their sectors and resented other colleagues such as Lieutenant [[Dedra Meero]] conducting investigations in their turfs. Following the [[Ambush on Ferrix|ambush]] on [[Ferrix]], Blevin led the Imperial takeover of the planet from [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]]'s [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|corporate tactical forces]] on the grounds of their incompetence in arresting a suspected local insurgent [[Cassian Jeron Andor]]. The ISB subsequently requisitioned the local [[Hotel Rix]] as the new Imperial headquarters on Ferrix. Despite Blevin's obstruction, Meero and [[ISB Attendant]] [[Avril Heert]] uncovered evidence suggesting that the recovery of a stolen [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit|Starpath Unit]] on Ferrix was linked to the thefts of Imperial military equipment and technology at various Galactic locations.{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} Following a successful insurgent [[Aldhani heist|heist]] at an [[Aldhani dam|Imperial dam]] on [[Aldhani]], Major Partagaz summoned several ISB agents and ordered them to come up with a punitive Star Sector and Planetary Emergency plans in response to the attack.{{Andor|The Eye}} In response, Yularen met with Emperor Palpatine and convinced him to grant the Bureau several key concessions including access to [[Imperial Military]] resources, new laws giving the Bureau unprecedented powers of search, surveillance, and seizure, and a new [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]] which increased prison terms and fines. The ISB also imposed a punitive tax on sectors harboring insurgent activity and arrested 134 Aldhani residents on suspicion of abetting the insurgents. Lieutenant Meero took advantage of the ISB's new powers to accelerate her investigation into the stolen Starpath unit and other Imperial equipment. When Blevin accused Meero of interfering in his sector, Meero successfully convinced Partagaz that the Rebellion ignored his artificial sectorial boundaries and theorized that there was a organized rebel effort to obtain Imperial military components across different sectors. Impressed, Partagaz reassigned Ferrix and the [[Free Trade sector|Morlana sector]] to Meero. Continuing her investigation, Meero questioned the former Preox-Morlana [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]], who informed her about the fugitive Andor. Based on this information, Meero theorized that Andor was attempting to sell the Starpath Unit to a shadowy insurgent figure code named "[[Luthen Rael|Axis]]." She convinced Partagaz to provide her investigation with expensive surveillance equipment, local agent funding and a [[Code Droid]].{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} Unbeknownst to Meero, some days earlier [[Surveillance (Imperial Security Bureau)|ISB Surveillance]] had already captured a photo of Axis, as he was landing on [[Ferrix City]]'s [[Ferrix Terminal]].''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' Consequently, Imperial forces on Ferrix were able to intercept [[Bix Caleen]]'s radio transmission to Axis. In response, local Imperial forces arrested Caleen and the transmitter's owner [[Salman Paak]]. Meero subsequently traveled to Ferrix to personally interrogate Caleen. In response to Caleen's defiance, Meero allowed Dr. [[Gorst]] to [[torture]] her with recordings of the cries of doomed [[Dizonite]]s. Meero also convinced the local Imperial garrison commander [[Prefect]] [[Vanis Tigo]] to spare Caleen since she was the only one who could identify Axis. She however allowed him to execute Paak as an example to the local population. Later, Meero briefed Major Partagaz about Caleen's interrogation. While Caleen yielded no information about Axis, she correctly deduced that Andor was linked to both the Ferrix and Aldhani incidents since Caleen and Imperial Army witnesses had identified the suspect as clean-shaven. Meero also informed Partagaz that she was using Andor's adoptive mother [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]] as bait. [[File:WellPlayed-Andor7.png|thumb|right|250px|Major Partagaz and the ambitious Supervisor Dedra Meero]] After Imperial forces captured a rebel pilot using a stolen Imperial masking unit and learnt that [[Anto Kreegyr]]'s [[Anto Kreegyr's group|group]] were planning to raid a power station at [[Spellhaus]], Meero convinced her ISB colleagues to kill the pilot and stage an accident for the purpose of luring Kreegyr's group into a trap on Spellhaus. Partagaz approved of Meero's plan and scheduled a meeting with [[Imperial Intelligence|Military Intelligence]] to discuss countering the planned insurgent raid. Per Meero's plan, the dead pilot and their ship was recovered by Kreegyr's insurgents near [[Ring of Kafrene|Kafrene]]. They believed the Kafrene's authorities staged story that the pilot had perished while exiting [[hyperspace]] as a result of a hydraulic failure. As a secret double agent working for Axis (the antique dealer [[Luthen Rael]]), [[Supervisor]] [[Lonni Jung]] warned Rael that the ISB was aware of Kreegyr's upcoming raid on Spellhaus and that Meero was a threat to the rebel network. However, Rael decided to sacrifice Kreegyr's faction in order to mislead the ISB into believing that they had the upper hand. Meanwhile, the ISB Attendant [[Corv]] spied on the Rael's operative [[Cinta Kaz]] while she monitored the ill Maarva's residence.{{Andor|One Way Out}} Following the death of Maarva, Meero convinced Prefect Tigo to allow the locals to hold a funeral procession in the hope of luring her adoptive son Andor out of hiding. In addition, Attendant Corv continued his surveillance of Kaz and Andor's friends [[Brasso]] and [[B2EMO]]. Corv later questioned Caleen whether Kreegyr was the elusive "Axis."{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} Meero's plan to lure Kreegyr's group into a [[Spellhaus attack|trap]] on Spellhaus succeeded. All insurgents participating in the raid were killed. While Partagaz was jubilant and closed the case, Meero was upset that the Imperial authorities had taken no prisoners since they could have assisted in the search for Axis.{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} Despite the Imperial victory, Rael managed to convince the [[Partisans]]' leader [[Saw Gerrera]] not to take part in Kreegyr's raid and not to warn Kreegyr, leading Partagaz to believe that the Bureau was winning the struggle. Meero then proceeded with her plan to trap Andor during Maarva's funeral procession. Confident that her plan would succeed, Meero rebuffed Imperial Military Lieutenant [[Merzin Keysax]]'s suggestion that they deploy snipers and containment units for the operation. However, Meero failed to anticipate that the late Maarva would use her funeral to deliver a posthumous speech urging the inhabitants of Ferrix to resist Imperial rule. During the ensuing riot, Paak's son [[Wilmon Paak]] hurled a bomb which killed and wounded several Imperial personnel, and damaged the local Imperial headquarters. As a result, Andor was able to escape and subsequently reestablished contact with Rael, who recruited him into the Rebellion for a second time. In addition, Caleen, Brasso, Wilmon, and B2EMO escaped offworld. During the chaos, Corv was killed by Kaz. Meero was almost killed by the rioters but was rescued by Karn, who shared her desire to hunt down Andor. ====The Lothal issue==== {{Quote|It could signify the spark of rebellion. Next time they make a move we'll be waiting for them to snuff out that spark before it catches fire.|Agent Kallus|''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''}} [[File:Kallus.png|thumb|250px|left|Agent Kallus, wearing the distinctive helmet of the ISB, designed to symbolize their status and instill fear within opponents.]] One of the ISB's top members was Agent [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]], who worked in the [[Investigations|Investigation]], [[Internal Affairs]],{{WebCite|url=https://herocomplex.latimes.com/tv/star-wars-rebels-first-look-at-the-villainous-rebel-hunter-agent-kallus|text='Star Wars Rebels': First look at 'Rebel hunter' villain Agent Kallus|work=[http://herocomplex.latimes.com Hero Complex]|archivedate=20140713005248}} and Enforcement{{SWCT|set=Imperial Ascension|cardname=Imperial Security Bureau Enforcement}} branches of the organization and searched for signs of disloyal activity or insurgency. His primary mission was to ensure it did not spread into a full-scale [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|rebellion against the Empire]]. In 5 BBY, sometime after the passage of the Public Order Resentencing Directive,''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' the Imperial Security Bureau took special interest in the [[Lothal]]-based [[Spectres]] rebel cell, whose attacks on Imperial outposts revealed risks of sedition and gave warning signs of rebellion.{{Databank|imperial-security-bureau|Imperial Security Bureau}} {{C|version archived on June 2, 2017; content now replaced}} Kallus became a perennial foe of the Spectres before striking an unlikely friendship with the [[Lasat]] Spectre [[Garazeb Orrelios]], which led him to reconsider his allegiance to the Empire.{{Rebels|The Honorable Ones}} Kallus subsequently became the rebel operative known as [[Fulcrum]], who supplied the [[Phoenix Cell]] and Spectres with intelligence.{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}} Later, Kallus helped the Spectres [[Infiltration of the Imperial Armory Complex|steal]] Thrawn's [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]] blueprints from the [[Imperial Armory Complex]] on Lothal. This led Thrawn to realize that the rebels had a [[Spy|mole]] within the Imperial ranks.{{Rebels|An Inside Man}} Thrawn began screening the local Imperial [[sector]] command for the spy with the help of Yularen. To avoid discovery, Kallus framed [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]]. Despite Kallus' efforts, Thrawn realized that Kallus was the true spy but allowed him to continue operating in order to find Phoenix Squadron's [[Chopper Base|rebel base]].{{Rebels|Through Imperial Eyes}} Thrawn subsequently tricked Kallus into exposing the location of Chopper Base by disclosing information about the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] plans to [[Attack on Lothal|attack]] the Imperial Armory Complex. However, Kallus managed to escape during the [[Battle of Atollon]] and officially joined the Alliance.{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} ====Nightswan's campaign==== {{Dialogue|Colonel Wullf Yularen|Driller and Nightswan?|Juahir Madras|Driller mentioned someone with that name. But we only talked about what we could do to fix things. To make the Empire better for everyone|Arihnda Pryce|And then you thought about me and figured you could use me. Falling for the ruse, Kloris shared a recording of the conversation to his ISB handler Blevin at the ISB's Central Office the following day. Based on this disinformation, Blevin believed that they could use Fertha's gambling problems as leverage against the Senator while Kloris believed that Fertha had a gambling problem. Such changes seemed to come as a side-effect of ISB operations being sublimated to other organizations within COMPNOR and the wider Imperial system. The historian [[Beaumont Kin]] would later speculate in his book ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' that such events were possibly due to factors such as the ISB being primarily held responsible for the destruction of the Death Star, Director [[Wullf Yularen|Wulff Yularen's]] death on the Death Star, as well as a shift in strategy towards battling the Rebel Alliance, with more power placed upon the Imperial Military who preferred not to deal with any interference from a "political" body like the ISB, who was now known for their failures. ====The creation of the secret Zerek Besh intelligence network==== {{Quote|Zerek Besh syndicate has infiltrated the underworld into the farthest reaches of the galaxy. With the support of the Empire, the Zerek Besh quickly gained power and recognition as one of the most powerful syndicates in [[the galaxy]]. Barsha believed that with the Zerek Besh, the ISB would be primarily responsible for the Galactic Empire's victory in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. However, due to a [[Battle of the Revelator|conflict]] with his brother, [[Jaylen Vrax]], who sought revenge against Sliro, the Zerek Besh lost its leadership, as both Barsha and Vrax, who had assumed leadership of the syndicate, were killed. Twenty [[Standard day|days]] after the Battle of [[Endor]], the ISB kept information on the Emperor's posthumous [[contingency]] plan on one of its Black Sites, the [[Wretch of Tayron|Wretch]] of [[Tayron]]. However, the base was [[Raid at the Wretch of Tayron|taken]] by Rebel Alliance [[General]] [[Han Solo]] and his [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|elite]] [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]]. The [[Unidentified Imperial base commander|base commander]] was unable to initiate a data purge, and the Alliance obtained information on [[Operation: Cinder]],[[Shattered Empire 3|''Shattered Empire'' 3]] thwarting attempts at its implementation for over three [[Standard month|months]].[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]] [[File:ISBMorak-TMCh15.png|thumb|left|250px|The Morak Imperial remnant was run by ex-ISB agents.]] In the months following Endor, the ISB was given full oversight over the security of the Imperial [[throneworld]], Coruscant, after the Imperial Navy refused to provide [[Starship|ships]] to defend the planet, with [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Gallius Rax]] viewing it as a symbol of indolence and torpidity. As such, control of [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] was left to the Empire's [[chief]] [[administrator]], [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]]. While the ISB lacked the ships to effectively withstand a [[New Republic Defense Fleet|New Republic naval]] assault, ISB-loyal [[stormtrooper]]s and personnel were deeply entrenched on the surface of the planet, which was already involved in a [[Coruscant civil war|civil war]] between the ISB and New Republic–backed resistance movements. Near the end of the Galactic Civil War, during the [[Great Purge of Mandalore]], [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] was a member of the ISB and participated in the Purge.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}} After the [[Night of a Thousand Tears]], most of [[Mandalore]]'s forces were defeated. The ISB reached out to [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] to negotiate a ceasefire. Gideon told Kryze that all Mandalorian lives, as well as all cities that remained at the time, would be spared if she agreed to submit to the Empire and disarm. Aware of the shame such an act would bring, but believing the survival of her people came first, Kryze gave up the [[Darksaber]] to Gideon as an act of surrender. However, Gideon would betray Kryze, continuing the purge while taking the Darksaber for himself, thus causing the planet's devastation and abandonment.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} Velus joined a [[Norra Wexley's team|team]] of [[Imperial hunter]]s led by the New Republic [[starfighter]] [[pilot]] [[Norra Wexley]] after defecting to the New Republic.[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] After losing [[Krass family|his family]] during a New Republic [[Attack on the Hyborean Moon|attack]] on the [[Hyborean Moon]], [[Romwell Krass Junior]] abandoned his post and traveled the [[galaxy]] to grieve the loss of his loved ones.
